findings.finding: The PRE plugin package is USER/PRIVATE, its independent canonical Git source and license declaration are not identified, and its shared runtime is specified but not deployed. PR #34 implements a transport port and mapper, not a live adapter.
findings.disposition: Keep runtime state NOT_CONFIGURED until PRE/GOV-01 authorizes exact data-source access and a named host passes live read-only contract tests.

findings.finding: A bound transport does not prove that its credentials are restricted to the two PRE data sources or are read-only at the provider boundary.
findings.disposition: Require least-privilege credentials, source allowlisting and a negative write-permission test before host activation.

findings.finding: The normalized page contract does not provide an authoritative page/source last-modified timestamp. Capture time cannot be treated as source freshness.
findings.disposition: Preserve freshness UNKNOWN until a source timestamp or a GOV-01-approved freshness policy is implemented and tested.

findings.finding: Approval receipt JSON is captured as source data only. This adapter does not authenticate the decision owner or verify cryptographic signatures and cannot infer that a request is approved or applied.
findings.disposition: A separate authenticated policy-engine and receipt-verification contract is required before any approval-dependent orchestration.

findings.finding: The HSO Master Roadmap & Milestones database describes the HSO ecosystem roadmap and is not the HSMART engineering task source. Treating it as HSMART's roadmap would conflate ownership.
findings.disposition: Keep HSMART/GitHub as engineering source, PRE as evaluation/gate authority, and HSO roadmap as a separate ecosystem source.
